article.headline: Roddie Anderson III scores 17 as Seton Hall knocks off Charlotte 68-62
article.description: — Roddie Anderson III had 17 points in Seton Hall's 68-62 win over Charlotte on Monday.
article.linkText: Roddie Anderson III scores 17 as Seton Hall knocks off Charlotte 68-62
article.story: PHILADELPHIA -- — Roddie Anderson III had 17 points in Seton Hall's 68-62 win over Charlotte on Monday. Anderson shot 3 of 11 from the field, including 3 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 8 for 11 from the line for the Pirates (3-0). Devin Williams shot 5 for 11 and 6 of 7 from the free-throw line to add 16 points. Mihailo Petrovic shot 4 of 6 from the field and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line to finish with 12 points, while adding six assists and three steals. Keyshuan Tillery led the 49ers (2-1) in scoring, finishing with 20 points and four assists. Mike Walz added eight points and six rebounds for Charlotte. Chaze Harris finished with six points. Petrovic put up 10 points in the first half for Seton Hall, which led 36-34 at the break. Seton Hall turned a three-point second-half lead into an 11-point advantage with an 8-0 run to make it a 52-41 lead with 12:44 left in the half. Anderson scored 14 second-half points in the matchup. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
